title: GTIN: A Unified Framework for Joint Event and Time Prediction in Temporal Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2607.23556v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Temporal graphs are increasingly used to model dynamic systems in diverse domains such as social networks, financial networks, and traffic networks. Predicting both what the next event will be and when it will occur in these systems is crucial for understanding and anticipating complex behaviors, but has not been studied much. To address this gap, we propose a unified mathematical framework capable of capturing varying degrees of complexity across temporal graphs. Our framework is flexible and expressive enough to accommodate a wide range of network structures and temporal dynamics. Building upon this analysis, we introduce our novel approach for jointly predicting the next event and its occurrence time. Empirical evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing techniques, particularly in scenarios involving irregular event patterns and complex temporal dependencies. translated_title: GTIN：时间图中联合事件与时间预测的统一框架
translated_abstract: 时间图越来越多地被用于建模不同领域中的动态系统，例如社交网络、金融网络和交通网络。在这些系统中，预测下一个事件是什么以及何时发生，对于理解和预测复杂行为至关重要，但相关研究尚不充分。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一个统一的数学框架，能够捕捉时间图中不同程度的复杂性。该框架灵活且表达力强，足以适应广泛的网络结构和时间动态。基于这一分析，我们引入了一种新方法，用于联合预测下一个事件及其发生时间。跨多个数据集的实证评估表明，我们的方法在性能上始终优于现有技术，尤其是在涉及不规则事件模式和复杂时间依赖的场景中。这些发现...
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一框架GTIN，用于在时间图中联合预测下一事件及其发生时间，通过灵活建模复杂时间动态，在多个数据集上显著优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework GTIN for jointly predicting the next event and its occurrence time in temporal graphs, which flexibly models complex temporal dynamics and consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple datasets.
